record.body:
## Rationale

The user asked for better UI elements on every phase tab, not only Overview. Shared structured chrome (chips, progress, next action, requirements, waves) plus improved per-tab content UI makes the overlay scannable wherever you land. Leaving Spec/Design/etc. as bare markdown would leave most of the overlay feeling unfinished.

## Counter-argument

Scoping chrome to Overview only would ship faster and avoid redesigning matrix/prose tabs. That was rejected because the complaint was the whole overlay's plain presentation, not Overview alone.

payload.alternatives: Overview-only structured dashboard; other tabs stay prose/matrix as today
payload.choice: Shared structured chrome on every phase tab (chips, progress, next action, requirements strip, wave summary) plus improved per-tab content UI; tab roles stay distinct
